## Trump’s Approval Rating

Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of September 8, leaving him underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. As of Wednesday, the survey had garnered around 129,000 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term.
